title: Secreted Clusterin Inhibits Tumorigenesis by Modulating Tumor Cell and Macrophage in Human Meningioma

publications.title: Secreted clusterin inhibits tumorigenesis by modulating tumor cells and macrophages in human meningioma.

needs_manual_review_reason: DEEP-AUDIT (2026-07-14): publications[0].authors was truncated to exactly 6 names; expanded to the full 15-author Europe PMC authorString for PMID 38416702 (Ke C ... Luo OJ, Zhang H). corresponding_author re-verified against the paper's own correspondence footnotes (PMC11226886 full text via NCBI efetch): two <corresp> tags, 'Oscar Junhong Luo...(luojh@jnu.edu.cn)' and 'Hongyi Zhang...(hongyizhang@jnu.edu.cn)', confirming the existing 'Hongyi Zhang, Oscar J Luo' value is correct; no change made. Also checked GEO's own Series_overall_design directly ('Single-cell analysis of 18 specimens from 13 patients: 2 with meningeal, 8 with grade I, 4 with grade II and 4 with grade III') against the paper's abstract, which additionally mentions 'lung metastases' as part of a broader malignancy-progression narrative; confirmed this GEO series' own 18 deposited specimens do NOT include any metastasis sample (only meningeal/grade I/II/III, summing exactly to 18), so no scope or grade_breakdown change needed -- the metastasis material referenced in the abstract is not part of this accession. No per-sample molecular-subtype, brain-invasion, or outcome/survival data found describing this specific 18-specimen series in the retrievable portion of the full text; these fields are left as-is. MODALITY AND SCOPE CORRECTION (2026-07-10 fact-check pass): this record was previously classified 'bulk_rna_seq' with sample_count 27. Direct inspection of individual GSM records (e.g. GSM7476436, GSM6259989) shows this is actually 10x Genomics Chromium single-cell RNA-seq data (extract_protocol explicitly states 'single-cell libraries were generated via the Chromium Controller and the Single Cell Reagent Kit 3' v3', data_processing via Cell Ranger + Seurat, supplementary files are per-cell raw gene-count matrices), consistent with the series summary's own description as 'single-cell transcriptomic dataset'. modality corrected to scrna_seq, platform and pipeline updated accordingly. Of the 27 total GSM records, only 18 (GSM7476436-GSM7476453) are genuine primary-tissue specimens (titled 'S1' through 'S18', characteristics confirm grade: 8 grade I, 4 grade II, 4 grade III, 2 non-neoplastic meninges control, from 13 patients per the overall_design text); the other 9 (GSM6259989-GSM6259997) are IOMM-LEE meningioma cell-line samples (wild-type vs CLU-knockout conditions, a mechanistic validation experiment, not patient tissue). Per this corpus's established convention for mixed tissue/cell-line accessions (e.g. gse-174360, gse-42624), sample_count and patient_count have been corrected to reflect only the 18 primary-tissue samples/13 patients; the 9 cell-line samples are excluded from scope. grade_breakdown (8/4/4) and normal_control_tissue (2 meningeal) already reflected the tissue-only subset and needed no further change. Record id and filename renamed from gse-206647-bulk-rnaseq to gse-206647-scrnaseq to match the corrected modality (2026-07-11); confirmed no `related_datasets`/`related_accessions` cross-reference in this corpus pointed to the old id before renaming. Per-sample age/sex/anatomic-location/treatment-timepoint fields beyond grade have not yet been extracted from individual GSM records.

gene_expression_viewer.sample_label: All 18 single-cell samples merged (this record's own scope, per GSM inspection -- excludes 9 other GSMs under the same GSE that are unrelated bulk RNA-seq cell-line experiments, not part of this record's sample_count)
gene_expression_viewer.embedding_method: scanpy 1.10.3: read_10x_mtx of all 18 S1-S18 samples' deposited Cell Ranger output (GSM7476436-GSM7476453; the GSE's other 9 GSMs, titled WT/sgC/CLU with _1/_2/_3 replicate suffixes, are a separate bulk RNA-seq cell-line knockdown/overexpression experiment confirmed via live GEO library_strategy/title inspection, not part of this record), QC per sample (min 200 genes/cell, <20% pct_counts_mt), anndata.concat (unintegrated), filter_genes min_cells=3 (28156 genes), normalize_total+log1p, top-2000 HVG, PCA, neighbors, UMAP, Leiden (resolution 0.5, 26 clusters, igraph flavor). Gene panel deliberately trimmed to 50 (11 guaranteed meningioma driver genes + top HVGs by dispersion) from an initial 150-gene/112MB export, to keep the artifact well under GitHub's 50MB file-size warning threshold at this cell count (164,181, the largest single-embedding cohort in this inventory's viewer) -- the gene panel was trimmed post-hoc from the same ranked list, not recomputed, so the retained genes are still the top-ranked ones.
gene_expression_viewer.integration_note: All 18 samples were merged by raw concatenation, not batch-corrected/integrated (same approach ScPCA documents for its own merged objects) -- use "color by sample" to check for patient-driven rather than biological clustering. 26 Leiden clusters at this scale means several likely resolve to the same broad cell type rather than being 26 distinct identities.
